framing: All the mechanisms, and all the parameters except the guessed ones, are the full realisation of a scan of a real C. elegans worm: its cells, their 3D shapes and wiring (from electron-microscopy reconstructions), and published measurements of how its channels, synapses and muscles behave. The guessed parameters are the gaps in that scan that still have to be filled in.

labels.title: measured
labels.meaning: Read straight off a cited experiment, scan or electron-micrograph count. We trust these as far as we trust the one paper or dataset, with no extra step in between.

labels.title: published fit
labels.meaning: Another project already fitted or chose this value and published it (BAAIWorm, Nicoletti et al., MetaWorm, c302...). We trust it as far as we trust that published model; it was fit to someone else's data, not ours, and not refit here.

example.source: median of the per-cell values (values table)

labels.title: derived
labels.meaning: Plain arithmetic on a measured value, with the arithmetic shown in the row's source note. Mostly this is the 3D cell-reconstruction points and diameters (coordinates and widths digitized from BAAIWorm's EM-based cell shapes); a smaller set is one-line arithmetic on a measured quantity (a physical constant, a membrane area from a measured capacitance, an innexin assignment from measured gene expression). We trust these as far as we trust the measurement plus the arithmetic, which anyone can check.

example.source: Shtonda & Avery 2005 J Exp Biol 208:2177 (PMC1351090), Results: whole-pharynx electrical parameters (opened 6 Nov 2026)

labels.title: inferred
labels.meaning: Reasoned from a source by this project, not a straight measurement or arithmetic, and not a guess either: for example assigning a channel to a cell because its gene is reported expressed there, or picking a receptor's coupling from a homologue. Trust these less than measured or published fit; they are our best reasoned call, not data.

example.source: Güiza, Barría, Sáez & Vega 2018 Front Physiol 9:1414 (PMC6193117), section on innexons, citing Bao, Samuels, Locovei, Macagno, Muller & Dahl 2007 FEBS Lett 581:5703 (leech innexins in Xenopus oocytes; checked in the reference list)

labels.title: guessed
labels.meaning: A bounded placeholder, picked to sit inside a plausible biological range so the model runs, not read off anything. These are the real gaps: the parts of the scan we have not filled in yet.

reconstruction.note: BAAIWorm's 3D reconstruction of each of the 302 neurons: the (x, y, z) position and diameter recorded at every point along the cell, digitized from microscopy. This is almost all of the 'derived' total.

unknowns.intro: The big guessed blocks are per-pair (one guessed number for every connected neuron pair) or per-cell (one guessed number for every neuron). The plan today is to re-express each of those blocks as a rule applied to measured structure, the same way 'derived' already works for the cell shapes, rather than leaving them as flat placeholders.

before.rule: synapse strength = EM contact count x a unit conductance per receptor class
before.note: today one shared per-contact value times Cook 2019's measured EM contact count, for every chemical synapse and neuromuscular junction pair.

before.rule: gap-junction strength = EM gap-junction measure x an innexin unitary conductance
before.note: today one shared per-contact value times Cook 2019's measured EM gap count.

before.rule: receptor identity from measured gene expression (CeNGEN)
before.note: today which receptor class carries a given chemical synapse is guessed for most pairs.

before.rule: capacitance = specific capacitance x membrane area (from the cell reconstruction)
before.note: today one shared capacitance per compartment type, not each cell's own reconstructed area.

before.rule: channel density from a gene-expression map (CeNGEN, by selector battery)
before.note: today 189 of 438 channel-density numbers are guessed and 216 more are inferred, per (gene, cell class), not yet read off an expression map the way row 3's channel presence already is.

unknowns.after_note: from docs/worm/UNKNOWNS.md's verdict: 368 numbers remain unknown (43 shared rules + 325 gaps), the whole fit vector once the rules stand in for the per-pair and per-cell blocks.
